projects.title: Regional Rail Path Search Capstone
bullets: Compared search times on sampled public regional rail graphs using Python and NetworkX as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone.
Tested disconnected graph cases for path search on public transportation networks within the supervised capstone project.

research.title: Urban Bus Network Path Search
bullets: Constructed graphs from public urban bus route tables using Python and NetworkX as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Compared search times on sampled graphs and tested disconnected graph cases for public transportation path search under faculty supervision.

research.title: Bibliographic Data Query Performance
bullets: Documented query plans for public bibliographic tables as a student assistant contributing to supervised faculty research on query performance.
Compared indexed and unindexed queries on public bibliographic data using Python, SQL, and SQLite within the supervised research.
